name: node-small
description: Small deterministic JavaScript refactor tasks for AIR code-agent non-Rust baselines.

tasks.prompt: Refactor src/slug.js by extracting the per-segment slug normalization from slugify into a small private helper named normalizeSlugSegment. Preserve behavior and run node --test.
Refactor src/pricing.js by extracting the percent clamping logic from applyDiscount into a small private helper named clampDiscountPercent. Preserve behavior and run node --test.
Refactor src/http.js by extracting the status code success check from statusLabel into a small private helper named isSuccessStatus. Preserve behavior and run node --test.
Refactor src/users.js by extracting the initials calculation from displayName into a small private helper named userInitials. Preserve behavior and run node --test.
